meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show recorded output and cache-read token usage and mode attribution for the current Claude Code session, or locate the host's native usage report. Trigger: /caveman-stats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查看当前会话的输出与缓存读取 token 用量及模式归属
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想弄清这次会话到底消耗了多少 token。
copy.tagline_en: Check token and cache-read usage and mode attribution for the current session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know how many tokens this session actually used

howto.what: 在 Claude Code 会话里运行 /caveman-stats,会把该会话已记录的输出 token、缓存读取 token、响应次数和模式归属原样打印出来,它不自行重算数字。在 Gemini CLI 中则指引你改用宿主原生的用量报告。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 会话中输入 /caveman-stats 时触发。在 Gemini CLI 等宿主里它不会去读 Claude Code 的记录,而是指向该宿主自己的用量报告。

say.note: 原样打印当前会话已记录的用量报告
按会话汇总各自最新的已记录输出量
报告观测到的用量,节省量仍为未知

howto.what_en: In Claude Code, /caveman-stats prints the recorded output tokens, cache-read tokens, response counts and mode attribution for the current session; it does not recompute. In Gemini CLI it points you to /stats model or /stats session.
howto.when_en: Fires when you run /caveman-stats in a Claude Code session. In Gemini CLI or other hosts it never reads Claude Code transcripts; it points to a native usage report instead.

say_en.note: Prints the session usage report verbatim
Aggregates latest recorded output per session
